description: Per-directory coverage floors enforced directly in CI from the Cobertura report that
dotnet test produces. These are the only coverage floors this repository has.
Codecov previously held an equivalent set of targets in codecov.yml. It accepted every
upload and processed none of them, leaving each commit in an error state with an empty
report, so it never posted a status and the targets enforced nothing. Both the upload
step and that config were removed rather than left in place looking like a gate.
Each floor sits roughly a point below measured coverage so it ratchets against
regression without blocking current work. Raise a floor when its directory improves.
Branch percentages are computed from Cobertura condition outcomes, deduplicating
lines that appear under more than one class.
